status: retrospective analysis specification fixed before this run; proposal data already explored, NOT a preregistration
target: median dilution-corrected H2 vol.% in final GC-anchored window of next low-current stage
tuning: none; multifeature linear ridge standardized using training only, alpha=1; no test-driven selection
recalibration_phase: first reveal on Kth eligible cycle after training; phase sensitivity 1..K
online_order: predict before revealing any current low label; initial and revealed labels only; previous labels must finish before forecast time
primary_online_score: non-recalibration eligible cycles in evaluation blocks; separate pre-reveal score also saved
uncertainty: moving-block paired bootstrap with 5 cycles and sensitivity 10; descriptive within one MEA, not material population CI
predictor_quality: known high-stage pressure 29.5..30.5 bar; high temperature within training median +-2 degC; high GC span >=1 h and >=4 GC tail points
retrospective_quality: add low-stage pressure/temperature/GC span checks only as post hoc sensitivity, never model inputs
exponential: c + A exp(-t/tau), c>=0,A>=0,tau=0.03..100 h; fit full high GC after first 5 min; report profile residual support rather than exact physical constants
exponential_identifiability: SSE support <=1.10 times minimum (heuristic not confidence interval), tau ratio<=3, no boundary, asymptote span <=0.20 times observed median; no claim of true transport rate
